about: A refactor with behaviour to keep: two loaders parse amounts with their own code; both must use the one parser, and every amount must come out right.

engagement.title: Tally: one way to read an amount

goals.title: Every amount read one way
goals.objective: Every file tally reads gets its amounts right, through one parser.

todos.text: src/loader.js and src/budget.js each parse amounts with their own code, and get amounts like "1,450.00" and "$128" wrong. Make both use parse from src/money.js, so every amount is read one way, with tests.
